wholePhysicalScope: The named mapped Mendelssohn-Haus way 239961680 and museum garden-house way 70288358 correspond to the standing house and rear building in Saxony heritage entry 09290143. The neighboring apartment buildings are separate.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the four-storey historic façade and separate dormered garden house. Nearer levels add paired arches, sandstone cornices and roof detail.
limitations: The 1900 street image covers most of the original frontage. The precise current siding color, door and shop joinery, modest rear openings, roof vents and exact projecting dimensions are approximate.
The open garden is preserved between both models. Neighboring apartments, courtyard planting and interiors are outside the selected scope.
